description: US English glossary for privileged-identity and enclave terms. Translators keep these meanings consistent across packs.

elevation.definition: Temporary grant of higher privilege on an endpoint or system, usually with a short lifetime and an audit record.

vault.definition: Controlled store for privileged credentials and secrets with checkout, rotation, and access policy.

rotation.definition: Replacing a password or secret with a new value on a schedule or after use, with the old value retired.

checkout.definition: Time-bounded retrieval of a vaulted credential for an authorized operator or workflow.

session.definition: An interactive or recorded remote access connection to a workstation or system under policy control.

enclave.definition: The regulated boundary this product protects — systems, identities, and evidence under one compliance program.
